title: Market Minute 6-09-26- OpenAI Joins Heated IPO Race
title_zh: 市场纪要 6-09-26 - OpenAI 加入激烈的 IPO 竞赛
summary: After a mixed day on Wall Street Monday, stocks are looking to advance today. Crude oil is pulling back, while gold, silver, and Treasuries are mostly flat. The dollar is lower.
summary_zh: 周一华尔街涨跌互现，今天股市有望上涨。原油价格正在回落，而黄金、白银和国债大多持平。美元走低。

title: Psyched about the SpaceX IPO? Don't forget the brutal lesson from Facebook's IPO.
title_zh: 对 SpaceX 首次公开募股感到兴奋吗？不要忘记Facebook IPO 的惨痛教训。
summary: The excitement is building around the SpaceX IPO, which is set to debut on the Nasdaq Composite on Friday.
summary_zh: 围绕 SpaceX 首次公开募股 (IPO) 的活动越来越令人兴奋，该公司定于周五在纳斯达克综合交易所上市。

title: Anticipated SpaceX IPO ETFs: Massive Hype or Real Opportunity?
title_zh: 备受期待的 SpaceX IPO ETF：大规模炒作还是真正的机会？
summary: SpaceX IPO fever is lifting space ETFs, but history warns against chasing debut-day hype. Here's how investors can gain diversified exposure.
summary_zh: SpaceX IPO 热度正在提振太空 ETF，但历史警告不要追逐首日炒作。以下是投资者如何获得多元化投资。

title: ETFs in Focus as Anthropic Eyes a Blockbuster IPO
title_zh: Anthropic 着眼于重磅 IPO，ETF 成为焦点
summary: Anthropic's potential IPO could be a blockbuster. Here's how AI and IPO-focused ETFs may benefit from one of the biggest listings in tech.
summary_zh: Anthropic 潜在的 IPO 可能会引起轰动。以下是专注于人工智能和 IPO 的 ETF 如何从科技领域最大的上市之一中受益。

title: Bill Ackman’s Pershing Square to Raise $5 Billion from IPO
title_zh: 比尔·阿克曼 (Bill Ackman) 的潘兴广场 (Pershing Square) 将通过 IPO 筹集 50 亿美元
summary: Closely followed investor Bill Ackman looks likely to raise $5 billion from the upcoming initial public offering (IPO) of his investment ​management company Pershing Square.
summary_zh: 备受关注的投资者比尔·阿克曼 (Bill Ackman) 看来可能会通过其投资管理公司潘兴广场 (Pershing Square) 即将进行的首次公开募股 (IPO) 筹集 50 亿美元。
